description: OFW Features - Remittance Tracking - Track sent/received remittances with multi-currency support (USD, SAR, AED, SGD, HKD), exchange rate history, and YTD summary.
steps: Create lib/models/remittance.dart model with fields: id, date, type ('sent'/'received'), amountForeign, currencyForeign, amountPHP, exchangeRate, recipient (for sent), sender (for received), purpose ('family_support', 'savings', 'investment', 'bills', 'emergency'), method ('western_union', 'palawan', 'moneygram', 'bank', 'gcash', 'paypal'), referenceNumber, notes, createdAt

Add remittances table to db_service.dart in _createTables() and _ensureColumns(): CREATE TABLE remittances (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, date TEXT NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL, amount_foreign REAL NOT NULL, currency_foreign TEXT NOT NULL, amount_php REAL NOT NULL, exchange_rate REAL NOT NULL, recipient TEXT, sender TEXT, purpose TEXT, method TEXT, reference_number TEXT, notes TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
Add database methods to db_service.dart: addRemittance(Map data), getRemittances({String? type}), updateRemittance(int id, Map data), deleteRemittance(int id)

Enhance currency_service.dart to add getExchangeRate(String from, String to) method that fetches from ExchangeRate-API (https://api.exchangerate-api.com/v4/latest/{from}), with fallback to hardcoded rates if API fails. Cache rates for 24 hours in SharedPreferences to minimize API calls.

Create lib/screens/ofw/remittance_screen.dart with: (1) YTD summary cards at top showing Total Sent and Total Received in PHP, (2) filter chips for All/Sent/Received, (3) ListView of remittance entries with foreign amount, PHP amount, exchange rate, person, date, (4) FAB to add new remittance with dialog form

Add remittance form dialog with fields: type radio (Sent/Received), date picker, foreign currency dropdown (USD, SAR, AED, HKD, SGD, EUR, JPY, GBP, CAD, AUD), foreign amount input, 'Fetch Rate' button to auto-fill exchange rate and PHP amount, recipient/sender text field, purpose dropdown, method dropdown, reference number (optional), notes (optional)

Add CSV export button in remittance_screen.dart app bar that generates remittances_YYYY-MM-DD.csv with all fields using existing export_service.dart pattern, useful for tax reporting (BIR Form 1700 for OFWs)
Add navigation link to remittance_screen from home_screen.dart drawer under new 'OFW Features' section with airplane/money icon and 'Remittance Tracker' label
acceptance_criteria: Remittance screen shows YTD totals for sent and received in PHP
Add remittance form fetches current exchange rate from API and calculates PHP amount
Filter chips correctly filter remittances by type
Remittance list displays all key info: amounts, exchange rate, person, date, method
CSV export includes all remittances with proper formatting for tax reporting
Exchange rate caching reduces API calls (no more than 1 call per currency per day)
verification: Test scenario 1: Add 'Sent' remittance of $500 USD → tap 'Fetch Rate' → PHP amount auto-fills with current rate (e.g., ₱28,500 at 57 PHP/USD)
Test scenario 2: Add 3 remittances (2 sent, 1 received) → YTD summary cards show correct totals
Test scenario 3: Filter by 'Sent' → only sent remittances visible in list
Test scenario 4: Export to CSV → file contains all remittances with headers: Date, Type, Foreign Amount, Currency, PHP Amount, Exchange Rate, Person, Purpose, Method, Reference, Notes
Test scenario 5: API call fails → fallback hardcoded rates used (USD=57, SAR=15.2, AED=15.5, HKD=7.3, SGD=42.5)
